links.outcome: Accuracy and false-negative rates after deferring the most uncertain cases
links.effect: Deferring the 10% most uncertain cases raised non-deferred accuracy from 89.7% to 93.2% and reduced false-negative rates for melanoma, BCC and SCC in the non-deferred subset.
links.quote: Deferring the 10% most uncertain cases increased non-deferred accuracy from 89.7% to 93.2% and reduced false-negative rates for melanoma, BCC and SCC in the non-deferred subset.

links.outcome: Relative performance drop under synthetic acquisition artifacts
links.effect: CUDE showed a relative performance drop of 5.0%, compared with 9.6% for the deep ensemble. Both models degraded under artifacts.
links.quote: Under the predefined synthetic artifact protocol, CUDE showed a relative performance drop of 5.0%, compared with 9.6% for the deep ensemble.

unlisted_practices: Structured variational autoencoder with separate lesion and nuisance latent heads to reduce shortcut learning
Dirichlet-based fusion of stochastic ensemble experts for uncertainty decomposition

screen.reason: The paper tests a machine learning framework for dermoscopic image classification and specifically evaluates an uncertainty-based deferral strategy (deferring the 10% most uncertain cases) to improve accuracy and reduce false negatives.
